random_shared_control: Replace user IDs by one of 256 SplitMix64 hash buckets; use the same formulas, smoothing candidates, and validation weight search.
probability_storage: float32; training counts and transient arrays are separately reported. This is not a neural-embedding memory benchmark.
uncertainty: 500 paired user-cluster bootstrap replicates with seed 20261015 on warm-user/warm-item evaluation rows; conditional on the fixed period and selected models.
additional_control_reason: Include user-marginal effects so ordinary user bias is not mistaken for conditional-context signal.
limitations: No GraphHash/CCE/BACO model was fitted by this diagnostic. User-specific count tables and random bucket tables have different capacity; no claim of superior compression algorithm or equal-byte efficiency follows.
